## The company

InertialRange Labs AB is an AI engineering and data-platform consulting practice run by **Farrukh Nauman, PhD**, registered in Sweden (Aktiebolag) and based in Linköping.

I work as an **AI engineer and principal consultant**: I design and ship agentic systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — against real schemas and real data on enterprise platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Snowpark, SQL databases). When an engagement needs it, I also take **interim / fractional leadership** of data and AI teams. Across both, the constant is delivery: enforced retrieval, deterministic guardrails, result-level evaluation, and the test discipline that makes agents trustworthy in production.

## Founder

Since August 2025 I've been consulting through InertialRange Labs AB. As part of an ongoing engagement, I serve as **interim team lead for Data Science & Advanced Analytics** (Sep 2025 – Jun 2026) at a global industrial manufacturer, leading a 4–7 person team across telemetry analytics, ML, and GenAI automation — owning the roadmap, stakeholder steering, and technical direction.

Before InertialRange, I held AI researcher and consultant roles at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden (Jul 2021 – Aug 2025), where I led a Vinnova-funded applied AI project on circular fashion (**project lead, ~9M SEK**) and contributed as AI lead to the EU CISUTAC initiative (**~2M SEK**). Earlier, I held research positions at Chalmers University of Technology and the Niels Bohr Institute, and completed a PhD in Physics and Astronomy at the University of Rochester.

For my detailed profile, writing, and CV, see [fnauman.com](https://fnauman.com), and [selected work](https://fnauman.com/consulting.html) for worked case studies.

## Why this company exists

Most AI and data-platform initiatives fail for predictable reasons: weak validation, underestimated data readiness, and a gap between prototypes and production. InertialRange exists to remove those failure modes with systematic evaluation, clear scope, and delivery-oriented execution.

Running my own company also lets me choose the right engagements — the ones where I can take real ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.
